context: Standing operator confirmation (every found bug: register and fix, never ask); found by the main thread's 0.8.2 grill probes, 2026-10-30, on the work branch at 3fcd389 (published as 0.8.1). Block-list item (5): data loss outside the requested path. Contract: FileStreamWriter.start(path) writes the stream under path (its docstring example writes under a temporary directory). Present since 828cd86.
expected: A bare name resolves relative to the current directory (start('tmp') writes under ./tmp), and overwrite removes only files this stream wrote under that path, never entries of another directory.
repro: PYTHONPATH=repos/rand-engine uv run -q --no-project --with numpy --with pandas --with pyarrow python -c "from rand_engine import DataGenerator; from rand_engine.file_handlers.file_handler import FileHandler; b, f, _ = FileHandler.handle_path('tmp', 'csv', {}); print('start(tmp) targets', f'{b}/{f}'); DataGenerator({'a': {'method': 'integers', 'kwargs': {'min': 0, 'max': 9}}}, seed=1).size(5).writeStream.format('csv').mode('overwrite').option('timeout', 0.05).start('ages')" (prints 'start(tmp) targets /tmp', then raises PermissionError: [Errno 13] Permission denied: '/ages'; no file is touched)
symptom: start(path) joins f'{base_path}/{name}' (line 100) where base_path is os.path.dirname(path), empty for a bare name, so start('tmp') targets /tmp and start('ages') targets /ages. With mode('overwrite') the loop at lines 108-111 then calls os.remove on every entry of that directory: a safe run with os.remove replaced by a recorder passed every pre-existing entry of /tmp to it, and start('data') in a container would target /data.
title: writeStream.start with a bare name writes under the filesystem root, and overwrite deletes that root directory's files
